articles.title: Hawks practice report before hosting Comets
articles.description: The Harbor Hawks held an afternoon practice before hosting the Metro Comets. Jordan Vale is questionable tonight after missing the final drill with ankle soreness. Casey North is available tonight and completed the session. Coach Avery Lake said the team will reassess Vale before warmups. The Comets arrived after a road game, and Alex Rowan practiced free throws. The Hawks have not released a starting lineup. The team reviewed defensive rotations and worked on late-clock possessions.
